name: aiko-persistence
description: Witness-gated persistence for long, multi-step agent tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Finish long tasks against real evidence.
interface.longDescription: Keeps long, multi-step work moving through plan, execute, verify, and adapt cycles until a runnable completion witness passes or a genuine blocker requires user input.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Aiko Persistence to complete this long task against a runnable witness: <task>
